Bug_Details:
A class can be annotated with at most one scope annotation. Annotating a class with more than one scope annotation is invalid according to
the JSR-330 specification.
Bug_Explanation: The class is annotated with more than one custom scope annotation, which violates the JSR-330 specification that allows a class to be annotated with at most one scope annotation.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by instantiating the ExampleService class, which is annotated with more than one custom scope annotation leading to a violation of the JSR-330 specification.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test passed successfully without any errors or failures, suggesting that the presence of multiple scope annotations did not cause any issues during the execution of the test.
